name: The Long Tale
storyline:
A brave knight arrives at the castle to rescue the princess… but the princess is gone, and the dragon stayed.

With nothing but your courage and a relentless will to continue, you venture deeper into the cursed ruins. Each room holds deadly traps, obscure messages, and the echoes of those who failed before you.

There are no hints, no allies, no forgiveness. Only a long tale of trials, obsessions, and forgotten hope.
summary: The Long Tale is a brutal black-and-white pixel platformer where every step can be your last. No tutorials, no mercy — just deadly traps, instant restarts, and pure challenge. Jump, die, rage, repeat — and uncover the long tale behind the ruins, the dragon, and the missing princess.
